manifesto.p1: A team of ten pays $6,000 a year for a CRM, $1,440 to book meetings and $420 to shorten links. Those prices are set per head or per plan.
manifesto.p2: Running that software costs far less. All twelve zerosoft apps fit in one container and one SQLite file on a small server.
manifesto.p3: So we publish the code. The core of every app is AGPLv3: you can read it, change it and run it on your server without paying us.
manifesto.p4: If you would rather we run it, zerosoft Cloud bills per workspace, by usage. Adding someone to the team does not change the bill.
manifesto.p5: We started with the tools small teams pay the most for. What is missing is written down in the roadmap, and what ships goes in the changelog.

oss.title: Self-host it in one command.
oss.p: The core of every app is AGPLv3, with every core feature and no trial. Run it with Docker on a small VPS. Your data lives in one SQLite file and an uploads volume: back up those two and you have everything.
oss.b1: AGPLv3 core with every core feature
oss.b3: Your data in one SQLite file you own
oss.b4: SSO, audit logs and custom roles (/ee): in development

dev.label: Developers
dev.title: A real API.
dev.p: Create a key in settings and use Link, CRM, Cal and Agents over REST. Subscribe to events and verify every delivery with an HMAC signature.
dev.b1: Links; CRM contacts, companies, deals, tasks, pipelines, products and quotes; Cal event types and bookings; and messages to your agents.
dev.b2: Scoped zs_… keys, shown once and stored hashed. 100 requests per minute.
dev.b3: Link, booking, contact and deal events, signed with the Zerosoft-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256) and retried with backoff.

faq.title: Questions.
faq.a1: Self-hosting costs $0: the core of every app is AGPLv3, with every core feature. On zerosoft Cloud each workspace starts on a free plan and, past it, pays for usage: clicks, bookings, emails and storage. Seats are not billed. AI is billed by tokens.
faq.a2: From zerosoft Cloud, which bills usage above the free plan, and from Enterprise, a commercial license with direct support. The core is never billed.
faq.q3: What happens if zerosoft shuts down?
faq.a3: The code is published under AGPLv3, so you can keep running it on your server. Link and CRM export to CSV, and if you self-host, all your data is in a SQLite file you already have.
faq.q4: What do I need to self-host?
faq.a4: Docker and a small server. Clone the repo, fill in .env and run docker compose up -d. Data lives in two volumes: a SQLite file and your uploads. Without Docker: npm ci, npm run build, npm start.
faq.q5: Can I migrate from what I use today?
faq.a5: Link imports from Bitly (API or CSV). CRM imports contacts, companies and deals from CSV, with a preset for the HubSpot export. There is no importer yet for Notion, Linear, Calendly or Evernote.
faq.q6: What does AGPLv3 mean for my company?
faq.a6: You can use, host and modify it at no cost. If you offer a modified version as a service to others, you have to publish your changes. The /ee folder has a separate commercial license.
faq.q7: Do you have SSO and audit logs?
faq.a7: Not yet. SSO/SAML, audit logs, custom roles and white-label are in development as part of Enterprise. We will announce them in the changelog when they ship.

end.sub: Sign in with Google and use the free plan, or clone the repo and start it with Docker. The core is the same.
